Newsletter November 2023

Dear members,

The spooky times are gone, The first module is coming to an end and the new committees have been formed. With this we hope everyone is ready for this year!

 

Yours truly, Kind regards,

The Max Jansdam

Website

Did you know we have a website? SiteCie has made a site for us to use and we are planning on using it for managing events starting this month.

Upcoming in November

The Weekly gamenights organised by the board continue! Once again because of the poll they will happen on mondays. Make sure to come by the lounge and have a drink (They might not all be listed below, but are every monday). 

We are currently also considering to do it once a month on another day, because some members have expressed their sadness in not being able to attend any of the board gamenights.
